messages:
maria: Need a small launch playbook for the site: short hero + three mode cards, 1-line clarifiers, launch posts, benchmark post, webinar, and inbound form routing. Keep it execution-ready.

jake: Ill draft the hero and three CTA micro-pages. Suggest hero: "Ship predictable inference, anywhere." Then three micro-cards: Hosted (Try API), Dedicated (Reserve capacity), Private (Contact sales).

elsa: I'll give sanitized benchmark callouts: Hosted ~85ms median token latency; Dedicated reserved pools ~12k tokens/s steady; Private supports VPC + KMS/HSM. Also can add a short eng quote for the tech post.

ryan: Webinar: 30m total (20 demo/10 Q&A). Panelists: Maria, Elsa, a customer rep. Demo should show routing/fallback and Dedicated onboarding. I'll draft 6 panel Qs.

maria: For inbound forms: add hidden enums so SDRs can auto-route: deployment_mode=[hosted,dedicated,private]; interest=[eval,prod,enterprise]; region=[NA,EU,APAC]. Example hidden payload stored as string: deployment_mode=private;interest=enterprise;region=EU

olivia: Routing rules: if deployment_mode==private -> route to team-enterprise@; dedicated -> dedicated-sales@; hosted -> trial-nurture@. I'll implement in form builder and test.

jake: Post cadence idea: Day -7 teaser + webinar signup; Day -3 benchmarks deep-dive; Day 0 launch + customer story; Day +2 how-to guide. Each post links to mode-specific CTA.

maria: Also include 2 short prompt snippets per mode on each page (paste-ready). Keep them tiny and show expected latency note under each.

mkt-bot: Reminder: webinar slot confirmed Thu 10am PT. Calendar invites sent.
